title: ‘They wanted to break me, scare others fighting for our lands’: Assam activist Pranab Doley

ai.summary: Assam activist Pranab Doley was arrested under the National Security Act for protesting against a proposed luxury hotel near Kaziranga National Park, which displaced 45 Adivasi families. The Gauhati High Court quashed his detention after 117 days.

facts.claim: activist Pranab Doley was arrested under the National Security Act for protesting against a proposed luxury hotel near Kaziranga National Park
facts.quote: In July, activist Pranab Doley was arrested for joining a protest against a hotel near Assam’s Kaziranga National Park.

facts.claim: 45 Adivasi families were displaced by the hotel project
facts.quote: Of this, 9.9 acres have been earmarked for the project.

facts.claim: The Gauhati High Court quashed the NSA order
facts.quote: On November 6, the Gauhati High Court quashed the NSA order, stating that the “detaining authority had not applied its mind” while arresting Doley.

ai.background_note: The Gauhati High Court quashed Doley's NSA detention, marking a legal victory for land rights activists in Assam.
